nodes.label: Vite Environment Typing
nodes.rationale: The standard Vite client type reference was added because the original scaffold lacked ImportMeta environment types and the Supabase client could not typecheck.

nodes.label: Supabase Environment Variable Alignment
nodes.rationale: The app booted only after VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY was renamed to VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, matching the module's expected variable.

nodes.label: Task Dependency Order
nodes.rationale: The pre-flight scan records producers, consumers, conflicts, and ordered task dependencies to support safe parallel implementation.

nodes.label: Single-Page Hash Navigation
nodes.rationale: The application uses hash anchors for one-page section navigation, so BrowserRouter is intentionally unnecessary.

nodes.label: Tailwind v3 Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Tailwind was pinned to v3 because the project CSS and PostCSS configuration use v3 syntax; v4 caused compiled utilities not to be generated.
